title: Micro-Frontend Shell Architecture
description: A host shell built with Webpack Module Federation that composes independently deployed React micro-apps into a single seamless experience, with shared auth, routing, and design tokens.
highlights: Cut cross-team deploy conflicts by isolating release pipelines

title: Real-Time Collaboration Suite
description: A multiplayer document editor with live cursors, presence indicators, and conflict-free replicated data types for offline-first collaborative editing.
highlights: CRDT-based sync with zero merge conflicts offline
Live cursors and presence for 50+ concurrent editors

title: Headless E-Commerce Storefront
description: A GraphQL-driven storefront with incremental static regeneration, edge caching, and a fully composable checkout flow decoupled from the commerce backend.
highlights: ISR + edge caching dropped TTFB below 200ms
Composable checkout reused across 3 storefront brands
Backend-agnostic data layer via GraphQL federation

title: Design System & Component Library
description: A themeable, accessibility-first component library with an AST-based theme compiler, Storybook documentation, and automated visual regression testing.
highlights: AST theme compiler generated tokens for 12 brands
WCAG 2.1 AA compliant across all primitives
Visual regression suite caught 40+ pre-release bugs
